The '''Takobo system''' was a [[star system]] located in the [[Noonian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. It was located in grid square N-6 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and contained the [[planet]] [[Takobo]].<ref name="Origin" />
